title: Art style
description: A story's own art style (content/stories/<id>/style/style.json), written at the bible step and proposed until the user approves it. Stories never share a style unless a bible declares `styleFrom`. The app's own look (content/app/style.json) uses the same format without an anchor. Rendered into the story's REQUESTED_ASSETS.md: the prompt block is pasted word for word into every prompt of the story, and the anchor is the first picture to make.

status.description: "proposed, not yet approved" until the user approves it, then "approved".

summary.description: The look in a few sentences, and why it suits this story.

prompt.description: The style block pasted word for word into every prompt. Medium and technique only, never an artist's name.

anchor.description: The style anchor: a picture of the story's world with no one in it, made first and attached to every later prompt as the style reference.
